topic: What does recovering from burnout actually look like? (carousel)
caption:
Better, but not quite well? That stage of burnout recovery is common, and it has a shape.

Long-term research from Swedish stress clinics found most people improved a great deal, though only some felt fully recovered years later. People described needing quiet rest early on, and shorter, more active breaks later.
